//: Scopes are pinned deliberately. Left undeclared, Apps Script infers the
widest scope that could cover the code and asks for 'See, edit, create and
delete ALL your Google Sheets spreadsheets' — far more than this needs.
The script only ever reaches its own container via getActiveSpreadsheet();
it never calls openById/openByUrl and never touches Drive. So the narrow
'currentonly' scope is the accurate one, and the consent screen then reads
'only the specific spreadsheet this application is used in'.
script.scriptapp is the daily no-show sweep trigger ('run when you are not
present'). If you would rather not grant it, delete that scope AND the
installTriggers_/sweepNoShowsTrigger functions from Code.gs: the sweep also
runs lazily whenever anyone loads the board, so desks still free up. You
would only lose the case where nobody opens the page all morning.
